paper.title: Artificial intelligence for non-invasive glycaemic-events detection via ECG in a paediatric population: study protocol
paper.claim: The protocol proposes training personalized and generalized models to classify glycaemic events from raw ECG excerpts paired with continuous-glucose-monitor readings.
paper.population: Planned single-centre observational study of 64 participants under 18 with type-1 diabetes who already use continuous glucose monitoring.
paper.referenceStandard: Time-aligned continuous-glucose-monitor measurements interpolated against five-to-fifteen-minute raw-ECG excerpts.
paper.relationEvidence: The CC-BY article is a prospective protocol and publishes no completed classifier. The supplied Apache-licensed repository is not linked by the paper and contains supporting documents but no executable implementation or fitted model.

sources.name: CC-BY study protocol in Europe PMC XML

compatibility.brainstemContract: not-defined: proposed raw ECG and paired continuous-glucose-monitor study contract
requiredSignals: artifact-screened raw ECG morphology sampled sufficiently for fiducial and spectrogram features
time-aligned continuous-glucose-monitor values with paediatric type-1-diabetes study context
compatibility.window: Paper-proposed five-to-fifteen-minute raw-ECG excerpts paired to interpolated glucose measurements.
compatibility.preprocessing: Withheld until a completed study and licensed implementation freeze ECG sampling, baseline removal, normalization, beat segmentation, label thresholds, participant split, fitted model, calibration, and uncertainty.
mismatches: The current Brainstem C2D contract does not export raw ECG morphology.
Brainstem records are not paired with continuous-glucose-monitor reference values.
The planned paper population is paediatric participants with diagnosed type-1 diabetes.
The paper is a protocol and reports no completed data collection, fitted classifier, calibration, or validation result.
The supplied repository contains no executable source, model, split manifest, or reproducibility receipt.

cohort.output: Withheld; there is no completed validated model or compatible raw-ECG and CGM cohort contract.
